hook: Claude Haiku 5.5 costs about 75 percent less to run.
sections: It is Anthropic's fastest small model.
Think of a city courier firm. Vans are costly for small envelopes; a bicycle messenger is faster through traffic and far cheaper per delivery.
First, Haiku 5.5 runs on AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure. Second, it handles high-volume work like summaries, sorting and customer support.
Before, running Haiku 4.5 cost about four times as much.
Now it scores 36 on the Artificial Analysis index, cited by OrigoTech, ahead of the best open-weight models at 32.
AWS and Google Cloud gain. Our judgment: watch. Not financial advice.
